parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: The programming language, such as Java or Go.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The microservice namespace to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: SentinelEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the Sentinel component.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source of the application. The value is fixed as edasmsc.

parameters.name: SwitchEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the switch.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: Alibaba Cloud tags. You can perform filtering by Alibaba Cloud tag.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The custom tag key. It can contain up to 128 characters and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
